name: rayu-cli-workspace
description: Workspace root for @rayu-dev/agent-protocol, @rayu-dev/web-bridge-client and the rayucode packages. The rayu CLI (rayu/) is deliberately NOT a member — it stays a standalone Bun project. See WORKSPACE.md.

scripts.build:rayucode: npm run build --workspace @rayucode/core && npm run build --workspace rayucode
scripts.build: npm run build:protocol && npm run build:web-bridge && npm run build:engine && npm run build:rayucode
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run package --workspace rayucode

//overrides: zod is pinned to ONE exact version across the workspace. The protocol schemas and every consumer must share a single zod runtime: two instances make `instanceof` checks and safeParse results silently disagree across package boundaries. Must stay in lockstep with rayu/package.json. See PROTOCOL.md §5.
